title: Durable detached possibility stewardship
statement: An agent can preserve a source-grounded speculative possibility across development sessions and preflight it as a candidate new knowledge pack without placing unreviewed bytes in the active reviewed namespace; a later authorized agent reviews and explicitly promotes appropriate material.

alignment.basis: ADR 0038 calls for sustained reciprocal development and adequate semantic stewardship; ADR 0034 retains the agent as controller.

ambition.basis: Recombine the current producer and preflight, not a new engine.

horizon.basis: The DTR draft and existing validator provide a real source boundary and reusable mechanism.

realization.basis: At source_revision, the validator accepts only the active knowledge path; the new desired end is proposed, not claimed realized.

synthesis_basis: The previous DTR episode retained an unvalidated draft outside active knowledge. The existing possibility producer writes a new active-namespace proposal and the preflight requires that namespace. Combine possibility synthesis and reviewed stewardship with a detached, digest-identified new-pack check and later explicit review; re-entry remains agent-owned.
value_hypothesis: A later agent could recover and mechanically check speculative material without risking accidental inclusion in reviewed queries or requiring a preparatory copy to the active namespace. Current source/evidence and review still matter.
revisit_when: A later authorized agent checks the actual DTR draft and either promotes, revises or rejects it; or the source boundary changes: file:src/sensemaking_skills/semantic_architecture/stewardship_validation.py or file:src/sensemaking_skills/possibility_synthesis.py.
counterevidence: An isolated worktree plus the ordinary in-place preflight already suffices; the host without a compatible CLI remains unable to validate. Detached draft retention may impose maintenance overhead. No observed accidental promotion, measured time saving or independent use.
claim_ceiling: Source-grounded hypothetical product future and agent-owned synthesis; no automatic selection, realized benefit, reviewed pack, independent method improvement or transfer is established.
